why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81% overall, but CTR (-0.02%) and Long Click Rate (-0.23%) did not move, so the extra successes are not showing up as more clicks.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Reformulation Rate rose 2.42% on navigational queries; this is a secondary cut among many that did not survive correction, so it is a lead, not a finding.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The new ranker may help some query types and hurt others, but no segment cut was designed to test this.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison on Successful Search Rate showing the arms already differed before exposure would make the test unreadable.
A daily series by days since first exposure showing the lift fading toward zero would mean the result needs more time.
